properties.displayName: FinOps - Audit diagnostic settings on AI resources
properties.description: Audits that a diagnostic setting with logs enabled exists on AI resource types. All AI resources are shared endpoints whose cost is attributed by usage telemetry, so a resource without diagnostics produces cost that cannot be allocated to any consumer (it lands in the platform bucket). AuditIfNotExists only; remediation (deploy of diagnostic settings) is an operational task outside this initiative.
